# mwfl coding-agent context

mwfl is a C++20 thin layer around real native Windows HWND controls. It targets
64-bit x64 and ARM64 Windows with an MSVC-compatible ABI. It is not a
cross-platform toolkit, virtual DOM, or custom renderer.

Start from templates/basic-app. Derive from mwfl::WindowBase, implement
BuildUI(), keep controls as members, create them with ControlHost, arrange them
with Row/Column/Overlay using DIP values, and call RunApplication from wWinMain.

Control wrappers own child HWNDs and are UI-thread-affine. ControlHost creates
but does not own wrappers. Retained layout references already-created HWNDs.
Workers copy WindowWakeup, call TryWake, and update controls only in OnWakeup.
Return EventResult::Propagate for unconsumed events. No exception crosses a
Win32 callback. Never use mwfl::detail or headers under src.

Task sources:
- window: examples/hello/main.cpp
- form: examples/form_binding/main.cpp
- layout: examples/layout_gallery/main.cpp
- commands: examples/commands/main.cpp
- background work: examples/wakeup/main.cpp and examples/hot_corners
- desktop integration: examples/desktop_integration/main.cpp
- DPI/appearance: examples/dpi/main.cpp and examples/appearance/main.cpp
- complete SDI editor: examples/notepad/main.cpp
- optional Direct2D: request COMPONENTS d2d and link mwfl::d2d;
  D2DHost owns draw transactions and recovery while application data remains
  GPU-independent. See examples/drawing and docs/recipes/direct2d-drawing.md.
  Layout does not provide a Spacer API.
- optional Direct3D: request COMPONENTS d3d and link mwfl::d3d. RenderFrame is
  on-demand with structured minimized/occluded/recreated/failure outcomes;
  callback GPU views are borrowed and WARP fallback is explicit.
- optional WIC imaging: request COMPONENTS imaging d2d, initialize COM, retain
  bounded CPU BGRA8 pixels, and use ImageViewportModel for DIP Fit/zoom/pan;
  examples/image_viewer proves D2D cache recreation offline.
- property pages: examples/property_sheet/main.cpp and
  docs/tutorials/settings-application.md; stable nonzero page IDs, `command`
  calls `SetDirty`, validation precedes commit, persistence succeeds before
  committed state changes, and modeless sheets stay on the UI thread
- task dialogs: `TaskDialogOptions` provides buttons, radios, verification,
  progress, links and callbacks; controller values are callback-scoped and
  errors/exceptions are returned through `TaskDialogResult`
- custom dialogs: move-only `Dialog` uses the normal retained layout and
  structured accepted/cancelled/failed results; callbacks and controls remain
  on the creating UI thread
- Explorer composition: `examples/explorer` combines Rebar, image-backed
  Toolbar, stable TreeView, owner-data ListView, Tabs, Splitter, StatusBar, and
  context menus. Splitter forwards attached-pane notifications/commands/context
  menus to its parent; route `LVN_GETDISPINFO` through `HandleNotification`.
- tray utilities: move-only `TrayIcon` borrows its owner and HICON, uses a
  stable GUID, decodes v4 callbacks, and recreates after `TaskbarCreated`; see
  `examples/hot_corners` and `docs/recipes/tray-icon.md`. The HWND-free
  `TrayIconStateModel` makes initial add, retryable recovery, and detach directly
  unit-testable
- resources: `ImageList` owns its native list while toolbars borrow it;
  `Tooltip` owns copied text/HWND while borrowing owner/tools; `Menu::TrackResult`
  distinguishes selected, cancelled, and failed context-menu outcomes
- typed choices: `SelectionAdapter<Control, Value>` owns ComboBox/ListBox/
  ComboBoxEx values outside native item data, rejects invalid indices, and
  requires exclusive UI-thread item mutation
- tree/list data: use stable nonzero TreeItemId/ListItemId values; ListView is
  multi-select by default. Owner-data views use a shared VirtualListModel,
  HandleNotification, TakeVirtualException, and RefreshVirtualModel without
  storing application pointers in native items; UpdateVirtualModel preserves
  selected IDs across reorder

Notepad tutorial and compiled Agent recipe:
https://mwfl.github.io/notepad.html

Detailed usage:
https://github.com/mwfl/mwfl/blob/main/docs/agent-usage.md
OPTIONAL THIRD-PARTY AND RENDERING INTEGRATIONS

Generic HWND: mwfl/native_host.h; NativeHost owns a container and borrows one
same-thread direct-child HWND. Attach enables resize, focus, and synchronous
notification forwarding. Detach does not destroy or reparent.

WebView2: configure MWFL_BUILD_WEBVIEW2=ON; link mwfl::webview2; include
mwfl/webview2.h. SDK 1.0.4129.50 is hash-pinned. Run in an STA. Query Runtime
availability, wait for WebView2HostState::ready, keep callbacks on the owner
thread, use Restart after posting out of a process-failure callback, and Close
before owner teardown. GetController/GetWebView are borrowed. Offline tests use
NavigateToString. Reference: examples/browser and docs/tutorials/browser.md.

Scintilla: configure MWFL_BUILD_SCINTILLA=ON; link mwfl::scintilla; call
mwfl_deploy_scintilla(target); include mwfl/scintilla.h. Scintilla 5.6.5 is
hash-pinned. LoadAdjacent before Create. Public strings are strict UTF-16/UTF-8;
positions are UTF-8 byte offsets. Notifications and HWND calls stay on the UI
thread. Reference: examples/code_editor and docs/tutorials/code-editor.md.

Direct2D uses mwfl::d2d, Direct3D uses mwfl::d3d, and WIC imaging uses
mwfl::imaging. These optional targets never belong on core mwfl::mwfl.

PRINTING, OLE, AND SHELL

Printing: request COMPONENTS printing and link mwfl::printing. Keep document
content and PrintPage pagination authoritative outside printer/preview state.
PrintJob owns native transactions and aborts incomplete work; render HDCs are
borrowed. Preview works without a printer.

OLE: request COMPONENTS ole, link mwfl::ole, and use ComApartment::ole_sta.
Payloads are copied, bounded, and contain no application pointers. STGMEDIUM
ownership follows COM transfer rules. Drop callbacks are reentrant UI-thread
calls; revoke registrations before HWND teardown.

Shell: request COMPONENTS shell and link mwfl::shell. VersionedSettingsStore
writes its schema marker last. File associations are explicit per-user,
owner-marked, and reversible. Jump Lists require an STA and stable IDs. Taskbar
objects stay on their creating UI thread and are recreated after TaskbarCreated.
Handle unavailable, rejected, access, and COM failures. Reference:
examples/printing, examples/ole_drag_drop, examples/shell_integration, and
docs/tutorials/printing-ole-shell.md.

MULTI-DOCUMENT WORKSPACES

Use document_workspace.h for stable metadata, document_coordination.h for
active command routing and close plans, document_tabs.h for borrowed sibling
page HWND projection and destination-first transfer, and document_session.h
for bounded versioned atomic sessions. Applications own contents, undo buffers,
file stamps, and page destruction. Never store C++ pointers in tab item data or
use a hidden global current document. Reference and tutorial:
https://mwfl.github.io/document-workspace.html

DOCKING WORKSPACES

Start at examples/docking_workspace, docs/tutorials/docking-workspace.md, and
docs/recipes/docking-workspace.md. DockLayoutModel owns pointer-free metadata;
the application owns panel content, documents, commands, and HWNDs. IDs for
panels, groups, nodes, and floating hosts are stable, nonzero application IDs,
never HWNDs or pointers. All native work remains on the creating UI thread.

Mutations use propose -> native prepare/adopt -> logical commit -> native
commit. Roll back adoption if commit fails. DockDragSession separates hit test,
proposal, nonactivating preview, and commit; Escape, capture loss, destruction,
stale state, rejected adoption, and exceptions cancel without losing the source
layout. Expose the same targets through DockKeyboardSession. Floating windows
own auxiliary top-level HWNDs and borrow panel hosts; they do not post process
quit. Save only bounded, versioned, pointer-free committed snapshots in DIPs,
recover them against current monitors, and fall back to a deterministic layout.

OPTIONAL RIBBON, LEGACY MDI, GRAPHICS, TASKBAR, AND HELP

Ribbon: request COMPONENTS ribbon and link mwfl::ribbon. Generate UICC resources
into the executable. RibbonCommandModel stores stable pointer-free IDs, modes,
contexts, and copied recent metadata; RibbonFrameworkHost borrows the frame and
CommandSet and owns COM callbacks on one STA UI thread. Treat GetFramework as
borrowed, support unavailable fallback, and destroy before COM shutdown. Start
at examples/ribbon_workspace and docs/tutorials/ribbon.md.

Legacy MDI: request COMPONENTS mdi and link mwfl::mdi. Prefer the modern
DocumentWorkspaceModel for new products. MdiWorkspaceModel owns metadata only;
the application owns documents and views. Route stable MdiChildId values without
a global current pointer, collect every dirty decision before any close, and
destroy MdiHost on its creating UI thread. Start at examples/mdi_workspace and
docs/tutorials/mdi.md.

EMF/GDI+: request COMPONENTS graphics and link mwfl::graphics. EnhancedMetafile
owns HENHMETAFILE and is move-only. Recording HDC and Gdiplus::Graphics values
are callback-scoped. EMF frame units are 0.01 mm, playback rectangles are
pixels, PNG dimensions/pixels are bounded, and export uses sibling replacement.
Start at examples/graphics_interop and docs/tutorials/graphics-help.md.

Taskbar/Help: request COMPONENTS shell and link mwfl::shell. Reapply progress,
overlay, thumbnail buttons, and registered/active tabs after TaskbarCreated.
Stable IDs are application values; icons and HWNDs are borrowed. HelpRequest
accepts absolute local CHM/HTML or HTTPS only and never constructs a shell
command. Use LaunchHelpWithBackend for offline tests. Start at
examples/shell_integration and docs/tutorials/graphics-help.md.
